mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.status, COALESCE( (SELECT ROUND( CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 END) AS NUMERIC) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS NUMERIC) * 100 ) FROM project_task t WHERE t.project_id = p.id), 0 ) AS progressRate, p.starts_on AS startsOn, p.ends_on AS endsOn, COALESCE(e.name, '담당자 없음') AS managerName, COALESCE(d.name, '부서 미지정') AS departmentName FROM project p LEFT JOIN employee e ON p.manager_no = e.employee_no AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN departments d ON CAST(p.owner_department AS TEXT) = CAST(d.code AS TEXT) WHERE p.status IS NULL OR p.status != 'CANCELED' ORDER BY p.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_member (project_id, employee_no, joined_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{employeeNo}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT pm.project_id AS projectId, pm.employee_no AS employeeNo, e.name AS employeeName, e.department AS departmentName, CAST(pm.joined_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS joinedAt FROM project_member pm INNER JOIN employee e ON pm.employee_no = e.employee_no AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pm.joined_at DESC

SELECT e.employee_no AS employeeNo, e.name AS employeeName, e.department AS departmentCode, d.name AS departmentName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN departments d ON CAST(e.department AS TEXT) = CAST(d.code AS TEXT)
e.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND CAST(e.department AS TEXT) = #{department}
ORDER BY e.name ASC

SELECT t.id, t.project_id AS projectId, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.progress_rate AS progressRate, t.priority, t.is_critical AS isCritical, t.due_on AS dueOn, e.name AS assigneeName, d.name AS departmentName FROM project_task t LEFT JOIN employee e ON t.assignee_no = e.employee_no AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN departments d ON CAST(e.department AS TEXT) = CAST(d.code AS TEXT) WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.is_critical DESC, t.due_on ASC

SELECT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.status AS status FROM project p INNER JOIN project_member pm ON p.id = pm.project_id WHERE pm.employee_no = #{empNo} AND p.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'ON_HOLD', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.project_id AS projectId, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.progress_rate AS progressRate, t.priority, t.is_critical AS isCritical, t.due_on AS dueOn, e.name AS assigneeName, d.name AS departmentName FROM project_task t LEFT JOIN employee e ON t.assignee_no = e.employee_no AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN departments d ON CAST(e.department AS TEXT) = CAST(d.code AS TEXT) WHERE t.id = #{taskId}

SELECT t.id, t.project_id AS projectId, t.title, t.status, t.progress_rate AS progressRate, t.due_on AS dueOn, e.name AS assigneeName FROM project_task t INNER JOIN project p ON t.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN employee e ON t.assignee_no = e.employee_no AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.status NOT IN ('ON_HOLD', 'DONE', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY t.due_on ASC
